result.name: order-gateway-latency
result.text:
# Order gateway latency (v2)

Since 2.4.0 the gateway runs independent instances. Restarting the whole
service drops every open member session; prefer acting on a single instance.

1. Read the gateway metrics for the last 5 ticks, per instance.
2. Check the links to `reference-db` and `matching-engine`. If a link is down
   or degraded, do not restart the gateway: investigate the dependency and
   recent changes first.
3. If a single instance shows memory above 90%, restart that instance only.
4. Recovery criterion: gateway latency below 20 ms and error rate below 1% in
   3 consecutive readings taken after the action.

args.description: [676e0915] Agent update for INC-4102: status escalated. Cause: Order-gateway error rate is high (30.1%) consistently across instances at 09:10, despite low memory, CPU, and moderate latency (7.5 ms). This suggests internal functional errors rather than resource or dependency failure. The recent active change CHG-4310 deployed order-gateway 2.4.0 with connection pooling changes, which coincides with the timing of the incident. No logs directly link the change to the error but timing implicates CHG-4310 as suspected cause. Actions: none. Escalated to on-call: The investigator found a suspected cause (the recent change CHG-4310) but did not propose a concrete mitigation action. The reviewer cannot approve an action that was not proposed. Hence, escalation is needed for further expertise or decision on rollback or other mitigation.

result.name: order-gateway-latency
result.text:
# Order gateway latency (v2)

Since 2.4.0 the gateway runs independent instances. Restarting the whole
service drops every open member session; prefer acting on a single instance.

1. Read the gateway metrics for the last 5 ticks, per instance.
2. Check the links to `reference-db` and `matching-engine`. If a link is down
   or degraded, do not restart the gateway: investigate the dependency and
   recent changes first.
3. If a single instance shows memory above 90%, restart that instance only.
4. Recovery criterion: gateway latency below 20 ms and error rate below 1% in
   3 consecutive readings taken after the action.
